versions.content: AUTOSAR shall standardize access to non - volatile memory Type: Valid Description: An important software functionality is the access to non - volatile memory. AUTOSAR shall support read and write access to non - volatile memory. Rationale: Application Software needs to store data, which is available after a restart.
